description: Configuration settings module for a FastAPI project, defining environment variables, database connection, CORS, email, and security settings.

classes.name: Settings
classes.description: Main configuration class inheriting from BaseSettings, encapsulating environment variables, database URI, CORS, email, and security configurations.

methods.name: parse_cors
methods.description: Parses CORS origin configuration, converting string or list input into a list of URLs.

methods.name: _set_default_emails_from
methods.description: Sets default email sender name if not provided.

methods.name: _check_default_secret
methods.description: Checks if secret values are default placeholders and warns or raises errors accordingly.

methods.name: _enforce_non_default_secrets
methods.description: Validates that secret configuration values are not default placeholders.
